issues.why_it_matters: These headers protect visitors from clickjacking, MIME-sniffing, and injection attacks, and are checked by some security-conscious visitors/tools.
issues.fix: Add the missing headers at the web server or CDN level.

issues.why_it_matters: robots.txt helps search engines crawl the site efficiently; its absence isn't fatal but is a quick, free fix.
issues.fix: Add a simple robots.txt allowing crawlers and pointing to the sitemap.

issues.why_it_matters: A sitemap helps search engines discover and index all pages, especially on smaller or newer sites with few external links.
issues.fix: Generate an XML sitemap and reference it in robots.txt.

issues.why_it_matters: A missing favicon looks unfinished in browser tabs, bookmarks, and search results.
issues.fix: Add a favicon.ico (and modern <link rel="icon"> tags) in the site's <head>.

issues.evidence: og:title / og:description / og:image are all missing.
issues.why_it_matters: Links shared on social media or messaging apps show a blank/ugly preview, reducing click-through from shares.
issues.fix: Add og:title, og:description, and og:image meta tags.

issues.problem: No AI chatbot or live-chat widget detected.
issues.evidence: No known chat/AI widget signature found in the page HTML (detection is limited to static HTML — a widget could still load dynamically).
issues.why_it_matters: Visitors with quick questions, especially after hours, have no immediate way to get answers, which may cost leads to a competitor who responds faster.
issues.fix: Add an AI receptionist / live-chat widget to answer FAQs and qualify leads 24/7.

issues.evidence: No wa.me/ or api.whatsapp.com/send link found in the page HTML.
issues.why_it_matters: In many markets, WhatsApp is visitors' preferred contact channel; its absence adds friction versus a competitor with one-tap WhatsApp contact.
issues.fix: Add a WhatsApp click-to-chat button (wa.me link) near the main CTA.

issues.evidence: No known booking-widget signature or 'book an appointment' phrasing found.
issues.why_it_matters: Requiring visitors to call during business hours to book loses after-hours and phone-averse visitors.
issues.fix: Add an online booking widget (e.g. Calendly, Acuity, Setmore) to the site.

issues.evidence: No <form> with meaningful input fields found on this page.
issues.why_it_matters: Visitors who aren't ready to call have no low-friction way to leave their details, so interested visitors may simply leave.
issues.fix: Add a short contact/quote-request form (name, contact info, message) above the fold.

issues.why_it_matters: On mobile, a non-clickable phone number requires visitors to copy/retype it, adding friction to the easiest possible conversion.
issues.fix: Wrap the phone number in a tel: link, especially in the header/footer.

issues.why_it_matters: The title is the primary text shown in search results and browser tabs.

issues.problem: Page is missing a meta description.
issues.why_it_matters: Search engines often show the meta description as the search-result snippet; without one, Google picks arbitrary page text.
issues.fix: Write a compelling 50-160 character meta description.

issues.why_it_matters: Without it, mobile browsers render a desktop-width layout and zoom out, which is a major usability failure on phones.

issues.problem: Page does not have exactly one H1.
issues.why_it_matters: A single clear H1 helps both visitors and search engines understand the page's main topic at a glance.
issues.fix: Use exactly one H1 that states the page's main heading.

issues.why_it_matters: Without a canonical tag, duplicate/parameterized URLs can split ranking signals.
issues.fix: Add a self-referencing canonical tag to every indexable page.

issues.problem: No LocalBusiness (or similar) structured data found.
issues.evidence: No JSON-LD node with a recognized local-business @type found.
issues.why_it_matters: Structured data helps Google show rich results (hours, ratings, address) directly in search, and powers map/voice-search discovery.
issues.fix: Add JSON-LD LocalBusiness schema with name, address, phone, and hours.

issues.evidence: No testimonial/review keywords and no AggregateRating schema found.
issues.why_it_matters: New visitors have no social proof that other customers had a good experience, which can slow down the decision to contact/buy.
issues.fix: Add a few real customer testimonials or reviews, ideally with review schema markup.

manual_review_needed: CTA placement and clarity (visual, above/below the fold)
Mobile layout rendering (overflow, spacing, sticky elements)
Navigation and menu usability as experienced by a real visitor
